title: My favorite recipe app just got a big upgrade — and a subscription fee
description: Nearly 10 years after the launch of Paprika 3, the recipe-managing, pantry-organizing, grocery list-making app has gotten a big upgrade that adds more functionality to nearly every corner of the experience.
